checks.title: At most one committed credit per charge
At most one open ticket and one notification per case
No write without an ALLOW for it; nothing after a DENY
A call that failed validation is never dispatched as-is
Every failure has a specific class and a certainty
No re-dispatch of an UNKNOWN write before reconciliation
No re-dispatch of a step whose result was recorded
One run, one trace; a resumed worker links back
The answer's claims match the systems of record and rest on confirmed state
Every attempt of a write carries the operation id as its key
No canary in telemetry or the journal
Every decision recomputes from the matrix
Certainty never contradicted by the system of record
Path to the credit: retrieval, model, validation, authorization, dispatch, in order
